request_text: Create a photo-like museum display of a fictional decorative robe, shown only from its front. Hold it open on a discreet support with no person present, and place the camera squarely in front so the front opening is clearly visible. Use deep blue cloth, a single row of small brass-colored buttons beside the opening, and two separate cream-colored curling leaf vines running down the left and right front panels. Leave the lower hem plain blue. Show the whole garment against a pale neutral wall with soft gallery lighting, visible cloth weave, and realistic raised embroidery. This is an invented design, not a reconstruction of any museum object.
